summary.root_cause_text: Ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration); the provider was unreachable, so orders were processed without payment. The worker stalled in a wait state and the queue backed up. The cause of the stall is not confirmed.
recommended: Check payments-v2 reachability and readiness before retrying the migration.
Find out why the worker entered a wait state.
